title: Call surge log + quick follow-ups (Lina)
content:
AM Sprint notes (5/2) - 8:30am start

Top goals:
- 20 calls with target persona (CTO/VP Eng)
- Move 3 accounts from 'Intro' -> 'Demo booked'
- Clean up stale tasks in SF: add next steps, set reminders

Time blocks:
- 8:30-9:15 prospecting + research (prep 5 priority accounts)
- 9:15-11:00 call blitz (power dial + quick VM)
- 11:00-11:30 follow-up emails + quick notes in SF
- 1:30-2:30 personalization drip (accounts from yesterday)
- 3:00-4:00 demo prep / handoffs to AE

Priority account mini-list (today) - quick notes:
1) NimbusSoft (acct owner: Mika S.) - CTO is skeptical on vendor lock; highlight Private deployment + VPC. Call 9:20am. Next: ask for compliance team intro.
2) AtlasRetail - Head of infra on PTO; try VP Eng (Raj) 9:45am. Pain: cost per token spikes; bring Optimize suggestions (batching + 8-bit quantization).
3) Harbor Health - contact: Priya (platform eng). Mention dedicated capacity SLA; she asked for 99.9% uptime numbers (have quick stat: our Dedicated SLAs page).
4) OmniPayments - Demo follow-up, send pricing sheet + compute options. Put 2-week renewal reminder.
5) Ledgerly - warm lead from webinar, want benchmarks vs. current endpoint; send latency + cost bullet list.

Quick call scripts / voicemail (short) - use 20s pitch:
- Live: "Hi <first>, Lina from Redwood Inference — we help infra teams drop token costs and get predictable latency when serving LLMs. Got 2 minutes to see if this is worth a proper demo?"
- VM: "Hey <first>, Lina at Redwood Inference. Quick call about cutting inference costs and predictable SLAs for models. Call me back at X or I can follow up by email. Thanks!"

Follow-up email snippets (super short):
- After intro call: "Thanks for taking 10 mins today — attaching a 1-pager with Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs. Quick next step: 30 min demo? (two slots: Wed 10am or Thu 2pm)"
- After no answer: "Quick note — I tried you earlier. If you prefer email, here are two data points: 30% less unit compute w/ batching + 10-50ms typical tail latency improvements. Interested?"

Notes to log in SF (copy/paste quick fields):
- Outcome: VM / Left note / Spoke
- Next step: (book demo / send pricing / intro to compliance)
- Reminder date: +3 days / +7 days

Pipeline prioritization rule (today):
- Hot: Demo requested or live PoC -> escalate to AE (tag "priority")
- Warm: Eng contact engaged but no demo -> persistent 3-touch cadence (call, VM, email)
- Cold: No response after 3 attempts -> add to nurture (monthly touch)

Open items / blockers to raise in standup:
- Need updated Dedicated pricing sheet from Product (link previously outdated) -> pinged Marcus.
- Demo env for NimbusSoft: still need compliance FAQ for on-prem option.

Quick stats I want to hit by EOD:
- Calls: 20
- Demos booked: 2+
- New SF tasks created: 8

Brain dump — objections + rebuttals (for quick memory):
- "We already use vendor X": ask what their pain vs cost/latency is and if they have private deployment needs; offer a quick benchmark.
- "Lock-in concerns": highlight open model catalog + ability to route to cheaper variants + private deployment.
- "Too expensive": mention Optimize playbook: batching + prefix cache + quantization can reduce OPEX (have numbers).

Follow-ups to send this afternoon (copy templates):
1) NimbusSoft - compliance intro doc + suggest Mon 11am demo (if no reply, escalate to Mika).
2) AtlasRetail - cost comparison bullets + ask for architect meeting.
3) Harbor Health - SLA doc + request compliance contact.

Reminders to self:
- Update demo notes template with new latency benchmarks (ask infra team for latest perf table).
- Add quick links to Dedicated SLA page in templates.
- After demos, immediately create AE handoff note in SF with runbook and eval list.

Tone checklist for outreach: concise, metric-backed, low-commit ask (15-30m), lead with cost or latency improvement.

End-of-day quick log (fill before wrap):
- Calls made: __
- Demos booked: __
- Emails sent: __
- Tasks added to SF: __

Random notes / scratch: 
- Found Slack thread #growth about new benchmark slides (link in Confluence). Might reference in later email.
- Follow up with Evelyn on the pricing doc edits (she said EOD yesterday).

Questions to ask Marcus in 1:1:
- Do we have a canned slide for on-prem compliance checklist?
- Any change to burst capacity policy that I should mention to prospects?

-- Lina
